name: Bihar
metaTitle: Clinic & Hospital Management Software in Bihar | Lucoze
metaDescription: Clinic and hospital software for Bihar: Patna, Gaya, Muzaffarpur, Bhagalpur, Darbhanga, Purnia. Plain-English screens, ABHA number on record, DPDP-ready, data hosted in India.
lead: Bihar runs on volume — long queues, cash-tight patients, and a front desk that moves fast. Lucoze puts patient records, appointments, GST billing, lab and pharmacy on one screen, so nobody loses a file when forty people are waiting.
intro: A single-doctor chamber on a district main road, a diagnostic centre off the highway, a 30-bed nursing home in a divisional town — Bihar's healthcare is high-footfall and price-sensitive, and the front desk is almost always working in Hindi. When the OPD is full, paper slips get lost, a repeat patient is registered twice, and billing turns into an argument. Lucoze is built to move that queue: fast registration in short plain English labels, one record per patient, and a bill that adds up the first time. We're an early-stage product taking on design partners in East India, and Bihar is squarely in that programme.
points: A front desk that learns it fast
Lucoze runs in English, in short plain labels a new receptionist can follow, and onboarding trains your desk on your own patients. Search by name, UHID, ABHA number or mobile finds the record.
Register, pull the last visit, bill with GST, hand off to lab and pharmacy — all on one screen. Fewer clicks per patient is the whole point when the waiting room is packed.
Your patients' data stays in India
Every record sits in Indian data centres, DPDP 2023 compliant. Full CSV and PDF export whenever you want it — no lock-in, no hostage data.
Record the ABHA number at the first visit, generate GST-compliant invoices, and keep the paperwork straight for Ayushman Bharat (PMJAY) and state-scheme claims.
localContext: We set up Lucoze for clinics, nursing homes and diagnostic centres across Bihar — Patna's dense medical belt (Boring Road, Kankarbagh, Bailey Road, Kadam Kuan) where patients arrive from every district, and the busy chambers of Gaya, Muzaffarpur, Bhagalpur, Darbhanga and Purnia. The working language at the desk is Hindi, with Bhojpuri, Maithili and Magahi spoken across it. Support is remote-first: video onboarding that trains your desk on your own patients, hands-on data migration from your registers or old software, and WhatsApp, phone and email. Our team is in Konnagar, Hooghly — a different state — so on-site visits are reserved for larger hospital deployments, not every clinic.

faqs.q: Can the front desk work in Hindi?
faqs.a: The screens are in English, with short plain labels, so a new receptionist follows the same few steps every day. Onboarding trains your desk on your own patients, and search by name, UHID, ABHA number or mobile finds the record.

faqs.q: You're based in West Bengal — how do you support a clinic in Bihar?
faqs.a: Remote-first. We do video onboarding, migrate your existing data for you, and stay reachable on WhatsApp, phone and email. On-site visits are reserved for larger hospital rollouts.

faqs.q: Can we handle Ayushman Bharat and government-scheme patients?
faqs.a: Lucoze keeps clean patient records, ABHA numbers and GST-compliant billing so the paperwork for Ayushman Bharat (PMJAY) and state-scheme claims is in order. There's a 14-day free trial and you can be live in about 14 days.
